sceneHint: SMALL NOTES · ACTIVE IDEAS · NEXT BUILDS

notes.label: turn the EMG model into an explorable exhibit
notes.copy: Prepare a web-ready model, useful viewpoints, and a clear fallback so the prototype can be understood without slowing down the room.
notes.detail: Show how it is assembled, not only what it looks like.

notes.label: add a guide who knows the room
notes.copy: Let visitors ask about the projects, objects, and decisions already inside Lab 17 without leaving the experience.
notes.detail: A guide to the room—not a general chatbot.

notes.label: open richer project evidence
notes.copy: Give project windows a focused viewer for images, diagrams, prototypes, and selected process material.
notes.detail: More to inspect, without turning the desktop into a file dump.

notes.label: show what has been discovered
notes.copy: Add a quiet room-progress view with optional hints for visitors who want help finding the remaining objects.
notes.detail: Guidance when wanted; exploration when not.

notes.label: add a visual Version History
notes.copy: Create a small computer app that shows how Lab 17 changes over time through clear, visitor-facing update cards.
notes.detail: Make the portfolio itself part of the design story.

notes.label: make every object feel more physical
notes.copy: Refine scale, framing, lighting, hover feedback, and object movement throughout the room.
notes.detail: Keep the atmosphere; improve the response.

notes.label: design touch controls for the room
notes.copy: Tune close-ups, drag gestures, tap targets, and compact windows so the full experience works naturally on smaller screens.
notes.detail: The mobile room should feel designed, not reduced.
